import sys

MOD = 998244353

def mod_pow(a, b, mod):
    """Return (a^b) % mod using fast exponentiation."""
    res = 1
    base = a % mod
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        b >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    d = r - l + 1
    a = d // 2          # number of even numbers in [l,r]? Actually a = floor(d/2)
    b = d - a           # the other half
    nm = n * m
    # compute ans using modular arithmetic
    # ans = (mod_pow(a+b, nm, MOD) + mod_pow(abs(a-b), nm, MOD)) % MOD
    # then ans = ans * mod_pow(2, MOD-2, MOD) % MOD
    # if nm % 2 == 1: ans = mod_pow(d, nm, MOD)
    term1 = mod_pow(a + b, nm, MOD)
    term2 = mod_pow(abs(a - b), nm, MOD)
    ans = (term1 + term2) % MOD
    ans = (ans * mod_pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD
    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = mod_pow(d, nm, MOD)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
